notes:
Video downloads: When YouTube reports a sign-in check, expired account cookies or a failed n/signature challenge before ending with "Requested format is not available", the download now fails as a login or tool-update problem and shows that cause instead of reporting the link as unavailable. The cause survives long format-probe logs, and a concrete final error such as HTTP 403 or a timeout still takes priority.
Privacy: Links in download error messages and details are redacted more reliably, including links with quotes in their credentials and links cut off by the log length limit.
Command line: The top-level baocut help fits within 40 lines again.
Requirements and verification limits: macOS requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14+. Windows packages are unsigned and require AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable; GPU variants require compatible drivers. ffmpeg/ffprobe and an agent engine remain external dependencies. Automated release checks do not cover full UI/export workflows, live model or GPU inference, or paid agent calls.
